subject: Post-call recap: Executive sponsor alignment & procurement path — Vertex Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@vertexsystems.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@vertexsystems.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Executive sponsor alignment & procurement path — Vertex Systems

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our conversation and proposed next steps so we have alignment with your executive and procurement teams.

Key pain points you shared:
- High latency spikes on peak search traffic (95th percentile ~450ms) impacting user conversions
- Rising inference cost as model usage scales; teams want clearer unit economics and predictable spend
- Reliability concerns during daily end-of-day batch scoring and overnight reports

Business goals / success criteria we heard:
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to <=200ms for core search paths
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% via batching/caching/quantization recommendations
- Run a 6-week pilot (POC) to validate latency & cost on production-like traffic, then transition to Dedicated capacity if results meet goals

Executive sponsor and timeline:
- Priya Mehta confirmed as executive sponsor (will own procurement/contract approval)
- Target pilot start: April 6 — tentative based on legal/procurement review

Procurement path / risks we discussed:
- Preferred path: SOW (technical scope + success metrics) -> PO -> project kickoff.
- Legal review expected (2–3 business days once SOW submitted)
- Risk: EU data residency/compliance are not in scope for pilot; if needed this will add time for Private deployment discussions

Immediate next steps (agreed):
1) We’ll send a draft SOW focused on pilot scope, success metrics, and acceptance criteria by Tue Mar 3 (attached).
2) Aditya will follow up with an initial configuration and cost estimate for the pilot environment by Wed Mar 4.
3) Jordan / Priya to confirm procurement contact and target PO timeline (cc procurement@vertexsystems.com if helpful).
4) Schedule a 30-min exec alignment call next week (Vivek & Priya) if you want to fast-track approvals.

Attachments: Vertex_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW stub — scope + metrics)

If I missed anything or you want the SOW to call out additional acceptance criteria, let me know and we’ll update before sending to legal.

Best,
Marissa
--

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive sponsor alignment & procurement path — Vertex Systems

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Adding a short leadership-level summary for Priya and Jordan to frame the business outcomes and escalation path.

Leadership recap (for exec sponsor):
- Business outcomes: If the pilot reaches the latency and cost targets, Vertex stands to improve search conversion by an estimated 8–12% and reduce monthly inference spend materially. We should quantify adoption and baseline conversion during the POC.
- Key risks: procurement/PO timing and any additional compliance scope (EU/data residency) which would shift to a Private deployment discussion.
- Ask to executive sponsor (Priya): Approval to proceed with SOW -> PO cadence so we can lock the April pilot start; if we need to accelerate, we can provide a short-term hosted SLA with contractual fallback.

Operational asks for the team:
- Aditya: prepare a pilot configuration that targets the 95th percentile latency improvement and includes a plan for KV-caching and batching.
- Laura: support SOW review and coordinate legal redlines once Priya confirms the procurement contact.

Would recommend a 20-min call with Priya + Vivek next week to confirm PO timing and any executive sign-offs required. Priya — would Thursday morning or Friday afternoon work?

Thanks,
Vivek

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive sponsor alignment & procurement path — Vertex Systems

Thanks Marissa & Vivek — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Priya is confirmed as exec sponsor and expects a short summary doc for her finance team to expedite the PO.
- Procurement contact is procurement@vertexsystems.com (copied) — typical review window is ~5 business days once they have a final SOW and cost sheet.
- Pilot start: April 6 still looks feasible; Priya would like a 15-min check with Vivek next Friday to confirm timing after the SOW is sent.

SOW comments: please ensure the SOW explicitly lists success metrics (95th pctl latency target, cost reduction targets, and traffic profile) and a short rollback plan in case production impact is observed.

We’ll review the attached SOW this week and circle back with redlines.

Best,
Jordan
